versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateRxSa is called with Active is set to FALSE , the secured association is disabled and EthTrcvMac- SecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • the given API parameter Active is set to FALSE • the reception secured association given with An exists and has already been disabled then the EthTrcv driver shall ignore the API call and return with E_OK . Otherwise, if the addressed reception secured association does not exist, return with E_NOT_OK .
